takeaway: Stroke volume = cardiac output / heart rate; reference range 60–120 mL per beat.

lines.text: Which value is cardiac output divided by heart rate?
Divide it by the heart rate, written HR in the stem.
lines.say: Divide it by the heart rate, written H R in the stem.

lines.text: Cardiac output divided by heart rate gives the stroke volume.
That is the volume pumped with each beat; its reference range is 60 to 120 mL per beat.
lines.say: That is the volume pumped with each beat; its reference range is sixty to one hundred and twenty millilitres per beat.

lines.text: So remember: stroke volume equals cardiac output over heart rate.
